entities.name: Query protein 263 aa
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt P44723 from Haemophilus influenzae; identity and coverage are both 100%, E-value 1.92e-185.
Annotated as nucleoside triphosphate pyrophosphohydrolase, also known as MazG.
Predicted Pfam MazG domains occur at residues 28–101 and 171–228.
Sequence-derived properties: 263 aa, approximately 30.5 kDa, theoretical pI 4.94, net charge at pH 7 approximately −13.2, and GRAVY −0.631.
Reviewed homolog is annotated as a homodimer and as participating in bacterial starvation/stress survival by lowering cellular (p)ppGpp or degrading NTP substrates.

entities.name: UniProt P44723
observations: Reviewed Haemophilus influenzae nucleoside triphosphate pyrophosphohydrolase (MazG).

Function annotation: regulates the MazE-MazF toxin-antitoxin system during nutritional stress by lowering (p)ppGpp, potentially through direct (p)ppGpp degradation or degradation of NTPs used for (p)ppGpp synthesis.
GO annotations include ATP diphosphatase activity, nucleoside triphosphate diphosphatase activity, nucleotide catabolic processes, and response to stress.

entities.name: MazE-MazF stress response
observations: MazG-mediated reduction of (p)ppGpp is reported to protect bacteria from MazF toxicity during amino acid starvation and related nutritional stress.
